scenarios.description: Imported hierarchy; known devices have not yet been registered.
steps: Import locations; grouping locations stay empty.
Select only benches with confirmed devices and register awaiting inspection.
Document a current configuration assumption; review a transition.

scenarios.description: Older PC CSVs have linked plans but no survey or installed records.
steps: Import legacy PCs without hardwareSurvey.
Review provisional planning; possible assumed reuse stays zero.
Bulk-record a documented current assumption to make conditional reuse available.

scenarios.description: Six inaccessible PCs with documented HDD and mixed-drive assumptions.
steps: Filter by both source configurations and by site.
Review SSD + bay + memory conversion and both procurement estimates.
Save and reopen the plan; confirm no stock or PC assignment changes.

scenarios.description: Two partial surveys agree with assumptions; one records extra RAM.
steps: Review: the extra-RAM PC blocks, and its demand is excluded.
Change its assumption to the observed three-DIMM configuration.
Enumerate remaining parts, complete the survey and commission through normal actions.

scenarios.description: Two recorded PCs, outside-scope reservations, unusable stock and inactive PCs.
steps: Select the first two PCs; inspect full procurement.
Expect 2 SSDs, 1 cage and 2 RAM modules to order.
Explicitly selecting Parts only / Retired PCs blocks them; their stock is not free.

scenarios.description: Unknown source drive capacity, one missing measurement, and a pinned 6 TB minimum.
steps: Review: pinned capacity and missing usage evidence block two PCs.
Add measured usage to the unknown cohort.
Choose the high-capacity destination; all three become plannable.

scenarios.description: Known device presence with missing assumptions, evidence, or supposedly complete hardware.
steps: Confirm all four remain explicit blockers despite location targets.
Bulk-set uninspected, the current HDD assumption, and evidence.
Review again: all four are provisional and plannable.

scenarios.description: 125 devices across two sites; 120 active and five inactive.
steps: Use source and hierarchy filters; duplicate bench labels must resolve by ID.
Select matching PCs across multiple pages; hidden selections remain explicit.
Review all 120 active PCs; save/reload a plan without changing inventory.
